clauses.reason: whole: Paragraph 4 of Executive Order No. 9279 of December 5, 1942, "be, and it is hereby, revoked", in order to permit voluntary enlistments in the armed forces. The order states no effective date, so the revocation was performed on signing, August 29, 1945. The command is exhausted by performance and paragraph 4 of EO 9279 stays revoked as a surviving consequence.

The held text ends at the signature date; the Federal Register page text before and after (a contents column) was not used. The order states no effective date, so the one-time revocation was performed on signing, 1945-08-29; paragraph 4 of EO 9279 stays revoked as a surviving consequence. The dossier's missing list names Public Law 89-554 as an acting identity absent from the census; no held text of that act that names EO 9605 or EO 9279 was found, and under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments a statute that does not name the target does not end it.
